blocks.title: The fast store of your node
blocks.description: The fifth store of the node’s memory, next to the database, the files, the vectors and the graph. It comes with every node and stays turned off by default: not every application needs it.

blocks.text: Its folder, its passport and its record in the core’s registry arrive with every node.
Its passport says off, with the reason, and the node installs it without starting it.
An element is turned on by the architect’s word or button, like every element of the node.
Redis is not built for Windows, so on Windows this element stays off.
A timer or a background transfer of this element is built only by the owner’s word, with its cost in memory named first.
